description: This file is a JavaScript plugin module for jQuery that adds image preview and resize functionality to a file upload widget. It defines configuration options, process actions, and extends the existing jQuery File Upload widget with image processing capabilities, including loading, resizing, saving, and metadata handling of images.

classes.name: blueimp.fileupload
classes.description: An extension of the jQuery File Upload widget to support image resizing, preview, and metadata handling.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image file and creates an image element if supported.

methods.name: resizeImage
methods.description: Resizes an image, potentially cropping or scaling based on options.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Converts a canvas or image element into a Blob for uploading.

methods.name: loadImageMetaData
methods.description: Reads image metadata such as EXIF data from image files.

methods.name: saveImageMetaData
methods.description: Saves image metadata into the image blob.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the processed image as a property of the file object.

methods.name: deleteImageReferences
methods.description: Removes references to image objects to free memory.
